h: Israel’s Eternity Remains Unbroken Throughout the Exile

p: that they correspond to the seven attributes
corresponds to the attribute of Netzach.
corresponded to the attribute of Tiferes,
which is the aspect of truth,
"The lip of truth shall be established forever."
and what can consolation help for this?
For the whole purpose of all the exiles
from the nations of the world.
And for this came the consolation:
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רמ, ב)
and as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 240b):
but Hashem Yisbarach is "laying" in the present,
"And I will lay your foundations with sapphires"
(as was explained on the past holy Shabbos).
And even though in the present we see
that we have not yet been saved,
along the lines of what is said
'The lip of truth shall be established forever,'
yet you had kingship for only a little while,
and immediately it was taken from you, etc."
'The lip of truth is established forever,'
it would be as you say;
but it does not say that,
the lip of truth is destined
that in the end there will be
"the lip of truth shall be established forever."
corresponds to the attribute of Netzach,
and for this, there would be no help
in the present there is an interruption,
and we have not yet been saved
so where is the netzach, the eternity?
"Who are you that you are afraid
of a mortal who will die,
and of a son of man, etc.;
and you forgot Hashem your Maker,
and where is the fury of the oppressor?"
And the Pesikta says (on this consolation):
It is like one who would see a worm
for it looked like a burning coal,
and it is called a glow-worm.
At night it is a glowing, burning coal;
that it is nothing but a worm.
כָּךְ אָמַר לָהֶם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
So HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to them:
Of a mortal you are afraid?
'how much less man, who is a maggot,
וּבֶן אָדָם תּוֹלֵעָה (אִיּוֹב כה, ו) וְכוּלֵּי
and the son of man, who is a worm' (Iyov 25:6), etc.
that they are nothing but a worm, etc.
that Hashem Yisbarach was the One conducting things
even in the exile, in the present,
"And I will set My throne in Eilam";
does it appear that they rule;
that never did any nation or tongue
only Hashem was always our King,
and He was the One conducting things;
there was never any interruption at all.
And this is the attribute of Netzach,
Who stretched out the heavens and founded the earth"
is always the One conducting things,
a son of man, a worm,
because of the fury of the oppressor?
Rather — "and where is the fury of the oppressor?"
Is not everything from Hashem Yisbarach,

p: And in the Gemara (Berachos 58a) it is expounded
this is the downfall of the wicked kingdom;
"And their lifeblood spattered on My garments."
is expounded on the attributes of Hashem Yisbarach;
so how did it expound it
as referring to the wicked kingdom,
from what is written, "And their netzach spattered,"
that they are the eternal ones,
"We, from the days of the world,
and it has not been taken from us, etc."
And the netzach of Edom and its strength
as it was said to him (Bereishis 27:40):
"And by your sword you shall live";
and regarding the liver, which is all blood,
אִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רלד, א)
it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 234a):
"The liver, which is the level of Esav";
and it is the husk of anger and jealousy,
and this is the root of all the husks
that Yisrael are the eternal ones,
And this is "And their netzach spattered on My garments,"
"And there shall be no survivor of the house of Esav."
And this is what is said
that it is the right one."
whether it means a Torah-based reason
for ordinarily one who wrestles with his fellow,
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֶּן לֵוִי
And it is like Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi
from what is written, "when he wrestled with him"
like a person who embraces his fellow,
and his hand reaches the right hip, etc.
Now this needs to be understood:
since he expounds it from a pasuk,
And also, what is this expression
since it is obvious to him
and he derives it from a pasuk?
We do not find this expression
when they disagree in the exposition of pesukim.
But this is the way of the Gemara:
was the one who began to reveal secrets,
and even he covered two handbreadths;
this is one who covers the things
that the Ancient of Days covered.
that here this was Rabbi Yehudah's intent:
was the guardian angel of Esav
עַל וַיֵּאָבֵק אִישׁ עִמּוֹ (בְּרֵאשִׁית לב, כה)
on "And a man wrestled with him" (Bereishis 32:25);
that he was not yet complete
such that "the lip of truth shall be established forever."
"And he saw that he could not prevail over him"
for he saw that he himself
was already complete in the attribute of truth,
"And he touched the hollow of his thigh"
that they were still cut off
from the attribute of truth of Yaakov.
on "And he touched the hollow of his thigh":
who are destined to arise from him;
This is the generation of persecution."
in the generation of the Destruction
we do not find that they killed prophets;
in the eyes of the king;
and also at the time of the Destruction
for they did not decree against the mitzvos;
was only in the kingdom of Greece,
and by then there were no longer
Netzach and Hod are the two thighs";
as is written in the Tikkunim
(בְּהַקְדָּמָה ג, א; בִּדְפוּס וִילְנָא ב, א)
"Prophets are from the side of Netzach and Hod;
And this is what Rabbi Yehudah said:
even though from the pasuk alone
לֹא הָיָה לוֹ הֶכְרֵחַ כָּל כָּךְ
he did not have so compelling a proof,
for he could have expounded "when he wrestled"
that he has a feeling in the heart,
as is written in Rashi's commentary (Ki Sisa, Shemos 31:3):
that the Ancient of Days covered,
and knowledge is pleasant to your soul"
and he has a feeling in the heart
that it is the right one;
who was the guardian angel of Esav,
wished to touch the right one more,
which corresponds to the attribute of Netzach,
that he is the eternal one,
which corresponds to the attribute of Hod?
And this is what he said: "and reason decides"
that it is the right one;
and this he did not wish to reveal,
so he said that he has a feeling in the heart.
and in the morning it says (Bereishis 32:32):
that he was healed of his limp;
are not cut off from his body,
and in them, too, there is
"the lip of truth that shall be established forever."
And this is what is written in the Pesikta:
that they are nothing but a worm";
and theirs is the netzach of holiness,
"And their netzach spattered on My garments,"
and the netzach is not theirs,
"And there shall be no survivor of the house of Esav."
And we read the consolations on Shabbos,
is the One conducting things even in the present;
"On the day that Hashem gives you rest
as referring to the Shabbos day,
on which Hashem Yisbarach grants rest
in the heart of a Jew;
in the midst of the hard labor,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם יֵשׁ לוֹ נַיְיחָא בַּלֵּב
nevertheless he has rest in the heart,
through da'as shining forth in his heart
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach,
in this world, which resembles night,
but in truth the morning will come,
and they will see eye to eye
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach,
as mentioned above from the Pesikta.
And from this there is consolation even in the present:
